label: info
info: Shows a two-line status on an EA DOGM162W-A (2 x 16, 3.3 V) on SPI0 with RS = GPIO25, RESET = GPIO17: line 1 the CPU load, line 2 a bar graph built from five custom characters. The bar is refreshed every 10 s with a random value; replace the function node 'random load' with a real source (e.g. a sensor flow).

name: bar glyphs
status text + bar
